brief:
Israeli settlers burned a Palestinian man's car near the town of Awarta south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported, citing local sources. The incident occurred in an area where settler violence against Palestinians has been documented repeatedly.

No further details about the vehicle's owner, the circumstances of the burning, or any injuries were immediately available.

title: Israeli settlers burn Palestinian's car near Nablus
